name: Jarrod Tran
headline: AI Product Leader | Enterprise AI, Strategy & Operations
summary: AI product leader who takes enterprise AI from pilot to daily use. At Tesla Energy, I built the forward-deployed engineering program and team behind 20+ production AI tools on Claude and Grok, with 1,000+ active users, and the investment model behind $156M in incremental annual profit. Earlier: iPhone India production strategy at Apple, Engineering Operations planning at Waymo, and battery and vehicle programs at Tesla.

roles.heading: Tesla Energy
roles.title: Lead, AI Enablement & Factory Strategy
roles.note: Rejoined Tesla in 2023 after Apple and Waymo.
roles.summary: I own Tesla Energy’s AI enablement strategy and the product team that ships it: roadmap, rules, and what I report to leadership.

bullets.text: Architected Tesla Energy’s forward-deployed engineering (FDE) and software engineering program for AI from nothing: deployment model, AI training, architecture (ARB) and security reviews. Hired the first 4, with budget to grow to 15.

Shipped 20+ production AI tools with 1,000+ active users, built on Claude and Grok models with terminal-based coding tools and tested with user feedback: RAG-based troubleshooting assistants, an internal agent chat, a hiring hub that cut time to hire by 2 weeks, and executive task automations.
Own the roadmap for a program open to 10,000 eligible employees: rank use cases, assign owners, pair releases with training and weekly adoption reports, and decline any use of personal data.
Freed an estimated 540 hours per week, worth $1.6M a year, by funding the tools that save the most time.

Built the Python and Tableau model executives used to rank 50+ initiatives for a $23M budget; the funded portfolio delivered $156M in incremental annual profit. Ran MegaUnleash, adding 7.5% California Megapack capacity.
bullets.webText: Built the Python and Tableau model executives used to rank 50+ initiatives for a $23M budget; the funded portfolio delivered $156M in incremental annual profit. Ran the site investment, adding 7.5% California Megapack capacity.

bullets.text: Redesigned the Megapack investment plan, mitigating $550M in tariff exposure during a 3.2× scale-up. For modules from China, timed foreign-trade zone entry and exit to tariff changes and fast-tracked more zones and exclusions.
Program Champion for a separate headcount and robotics program that delivered $260M in annualized savings.

Moved six separately planned functions (hardware, software, fleet, Product, Legal and Engineering) onto one Engineering Operations plan, with shared OKRs, resource plans and reviews for a 200+ person engineering org.
Replaced manual and emailed reporting with dashboards and automations for fleet health and milestones.

Owned iPhone India production strategy, taking sites in Chennai and Bangalore from greenfield to full-scale production as units grew 293% year over year (4.3M to 16.9M), program revenue rose from $2B to $10B, and exports expanded from 6 to 40+ countries.
Delayed launch to raise yield, then caught up through other initiatives.

roles.title: Program Manager, Special Projects
roles.summary: I ran new programs at Tesla, including the 4680 launch and the Model 3 and Model Y scale-up.

bullets.text: Took Project Roadrunner, Tesla’s 4680 battery cell program, from pilot to launch readiness through its public unveiling at Tesla’s 2020 Battery Day.
Led Model 3 and Model Y production planning and recovery for two years from launch, ramping each model to 10,000 units per week and hitting every quarterly production and delivery goal.
Designed and launched Warehouse on Wheels, a platform managing $3.5M per month in operating expenses.
Led 100+ associates in a 1M sq ft fulfillment center handling 350K SKUs.
